body.title: Route the four renderers and the three finalize sites through the shell, with the render-level suites
body.summary: Change renderErCompanion / renderUxCompanion / renderSequenceCompanion / renderComponentCompanion to take a required header, build page content via t5-t7 and render via renderCompanionPage (no more assembleShell). In orchestrator.ts resolve one CompanionHeader per finalize site (HLD, epic-Story LLD, standalone LLD) and thread it through renderErCompanionForBody / renderUxCompanionForBody / renderDiagramCompanionsForBody, replacing siblingSourceLink. In the same change rewrite render, diagram-render, ux-render, ux-integration, ux-mock-render, context-sections and companion-context-finalize tests to the new shell.
acceptanceChecks: Finalize at all three sites writes companions whose header shows the right source doc id and work item.
CompanionArtifactRef kinds and relPaths are unchanged.
A missing runtime asset still leaves the artifact written without that companion ref.
The rewritten render-level and finalize suites pass, and src/docgen/render/__tests__/shell.test.ts passes unchanged.

tests.name: finalize[standalone-LLD]: four companions with header (LLD id + work item), same header values on all
finalize[design.epic]: HLD id as source doc
finalize: missing runtime asset -> companion skipped, artifact written
finalize[standalone-LLD]: described definitions pass the HIGH gate and appear in the tables
docgen shell.test.ts + docgen pipeline tests unchanged and passing
